model: Formal F2[S4] register model of PR2583/PR2998: paid gates I+([s]+1)uv^T (u,v nonzero in F2^r, v.u=1), labels s1=2134,s2=1324,s3=1243 priced (2,1,2), free GL_r(F2), all roles dirty, spectators restored, literal endpoint diag([2143],[3142],[4231],[2143],1,...).

claims.four_roles: No circuit of paid cost <= 20 on exactly 4 roles; four-role optimum = 21 (an explicit cost-21 direct word, checked exactly by verify.py).
claims.five_roles: No circuit of paid cost <= 20 on 5 roles (one restored dirty spectator); five-role optimum = 21 (direct word, spectator untouched).
claims.three_target_subtuples: Coordinate-cut LP gaps: (4231,2143,2143) LP 15 vs direct 16; (2143,3142,4231) LP 16 vs direct 17. Both cost their direct values on three roles: by transfer from the four-role exclusion and by direct r=3 searches (0 words each); with one spectator by transfer from the five-role exclusion.
claims.not_claimed: Nothing for r >= 6 (two or more spectators); not a 21 theorem with arbitrary workspace; no native realization, supplier or kappa.

r5_independent_engine.note: explicit F2 matrices in the natural and ordered-pair representations; identical node counts to search.cpp r5_primary

controls.r2_instance: diag([4231],[2143]), r=2, counts (3,2,2): brute.py (unpruned, exact frozenset group algebra) and search.cpp (pruned) both count 146 words. independent.py (pruned) leaves 150 full-depth window survivors, of which exactly 146 equal T in exact F2[S4] arithmetic; 104 of these 146 words contain a mixing gate (u=3 or v=3).
controls.r4_positive: search.cpp with STOP_FIRST=1 on (2143,3142,4312,2143), r=4, counts (4,4,4) finds, for example (the word printed depends on thread order): s3:u8:v8 s1:u8:v8 s2:u4:v4 s3:u4:v4 s2:u4:v4 s1:u4:v4 s2:u4:v4 s2:u2:v2 s3:u2:v2 s1:u2:v2 s3:u1:v1 s1:u1:v1. This word is block-diagonal (u=v=e_i in every gate), i.e. a direct word: it shows only that the windows keep direct words at r=4. The control exercising mixing gates is r2_instance.
controls.scalar_negative: 4231 at counts (1,3,1): passes the count test, zero words (pruned and brute force), as PR2998 section 3 requires

lp_subtuples.method: cutlp.cpp enumerates all 2^24 coordinate cuts of the regular S4-set (10713 distinct profiles); lp.py runs an exact rational simplex on the cut-weight LP max sum a_H Phi_H(T) s.t. sum a_H c(H) <= (2,1,2). optimal_label_counts_n is its dual solution y: fractional label counts feasible for every one of the 2^24 cuts (y.c(H) >= Phi_H(T)), so price.y certifies the LP value from above. The matching integer lower bound for words comes from inv+c1+c3 (PR2583's L bound).
